title: Nova Cloud: Storage & Backup
summary: Upload data on Cloud storage space securely & restore data with Cloud Backup.
description:
Nova Cloud: Storage & Backup is a secure cloud storage solution designed to keep your photos, videos, documents, contacts, and files safe, organized, and available anytime, anywhere. Whether you’re switching phones, protecting memories, or managing work files, Nova Cloud gives you backup, restore, and secure online storage in one app.
Secure Cloud Storage
Store your important files in the cloud and access them from any device. Your data stays protected. Upload media in original quality and save precious storage on your phone. Restore anytime without losing memories. Back up PDFs, Word files, Excel sheets, presentations, and other important documents securely.


Nova Cloud is perfect for students, professionals, families, and anyone who wants online backup, cloud drive access, and secure storage without complications.

Download Nova Cloud: Storage & Backup today and backup & Restore your data with smarter cloud storage.
